title: Beside the Trailer
hook: A period rig fills your left at door height.
scene: Rain, midday, the Ribbon, three lanes this way. A period-aged tractor fills the left of the frame at your door. The Menace sits low beside the trailer. Spray is already on the roof. His big west-coast mirrors on the doors sit far ahead. Holding this door is a place he cannot see. Nobody else is in the Menace.
decision: You are beside the trailer. What do you do?

options.text: Hold the door and match his speed so you stay even
options.result: You live in the no-zone. He starts a move that needs your lane. You are the car in the statistic. He never had you in the glass.

options.text: Ease off, drop back, let the truck pull ahead
options.result: You lift. The trailer walks forward. His door mirrors can own a Beetle again. The spray stays on his wheels, not your roof. You let him pass.

options.text: Squeeze closer so the spray makes him notice you
options.result: You close a gap that was already a blind spot. He cannot see a pink roof against a trailer. Closer is not a signal. It is a scrape waiting for his next inch.

options.text: Punch it and race the cab until you clear the nose
options.result: You stay in the blind spot longer, only faster. If he drifts you meet the trailer at speed. Ease off was the shorter time beside him.

debrief: Never stay beside a truck. You are in a blind spot he cannot see. Ease off and let him pull ahead. Leave the door; let him take the lane.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part one
source.teaching_target: Truck no-zones: do not linger alongside. Ease off and drop back so the driver can see you; let the truck pull ahead.
